scope.description: Local read-barrier response correlation for distinct, concurrently pending remote requests in a stable leader term and fixed voting membership, after current-term commitment and valid quorum confirmation.
assumptions: Non-Byzantine peers and genuine response messages from contextual heartbeats
Distinct nonzero request contexts remain associated with their originating requests
Caller honors Peer update persistence/Commit and local applied-index duties
excluded: A numeric client completion deadline or proof of infinite stall
Restart, membership transition, context collision and Byzantine inputs

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No target code changed. Memory storage is used without crashes; deterministic transport send-loss policy and abstract bootstrap/noop application replace outer layers.
All observations occur synchronously between calls; no concurrency, sleeps, termination or private protocol state injection.

plan_uncertainties: This is local response-correlation, not a client deadline or global linearizability measurement.
A non-release would make this implication hold without testing emission; actual release is recorded separately.
grounding_unresolved: No real transport queue saturation or client RequestState timeout is executed; these are scope limits, not observed outcomes.
